body:
Removes `spawn.ceilings.codex.fast_mode` from the board config at the user's request.

## Effect

Deleting the key lets the runtime fall back to its own default rather than pinning fast mode on. Preflight after the change:

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `resolved_role_ceiling.fast_mode` | `false` |
| `fast_mode_source` | `default` |
| `admitted_pairs` | `gpt-5.6-sol` / `high` (unchanged) |
| `resolution_model` | `gpt-5.6-sol` (unchanged) |

Admission is unaffected — only the fast-mode flag changes.

## Context

`fast_mode: true` arrived on trunk with `STORY-260830-1fa5vy` (land-codex-fast-policy-on-fresh-trunk), not by a deliberate choice in this session. The user asked to take it back out.

## Note

The commit is unsigned, matching this repository's existing trunk practice rather than the signed-delivery ideal. Flagging rather than presenting it as compliant.
